dedupe_keys.name: building damage assessment of adassil morocco after 2023 marrakesh safi earthquake

description: This deposit lists a building-damage shapefile for Adassil in Morocco after the 2023 Marrakesh–Safi earthquake. Zenodo provides one public ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The provider says damaged and undamaged building footprints were assembled from Google building data, humanitarian OpenStreetMap, Maxar satellite imagery and the segment-geospatial package. These labels could support local damage-rate or exposure tests for earthquake impact simulations, provided the footprint source and classification method are checked. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Adassil damage map. Coverage is one town and one event; it cannot stand for all Moroccan building types or shaking intensities. A limitation is that the page does not state survey dates, damage grades, validation sample, coordinate system or distinction between image interpretation and field inspection. Rights in upstream imagery and derived footprints may differ from the Zenodo licence label. The ZIP was not downloaded and no damaged-building count was independently verified.
